decks.notes: The deck focuses on establishing a lock down control through mana ramping with the UrzaTron lands and utilizing Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opponents' strategies while also providing access to powerful artifacts. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Chalice of the Void and Ensnaring Bridge to control the board and Mystic Forge for card advantage. The strategy is to disrupt opponents' plays, build up mana quickly, and ultimately overwhelm them with powerful artifacts and control elements.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on applying early pressure with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf, while disrupting the opponent with hand disruption spells such as Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six to control the game and generate value. Urza's Saga serves as a powerful artifact engine, providing additional threats and ways to tutor for key cards like Shadowspear. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while maintaining card advantage and controlling the board.

This deck focuses on filling the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures. The deck includes cards like Architects of Will and Curator of Mysteries to help manipulate the graveyard, along with cards like Violent Outburst to enable the combo. Additionally, there are disruptive creatures like Grief and disruptive spells like Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan while the combo is being set up.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to put pressure on the opponent quickly and disrupt their game plan with counterspells and removal. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent provide strong threats that can end the game quickly if left unanswered, while cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat deal with opposing creatures. The deck also includes card selection and filtering through Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to ensure that it can consistently apply pressure and control the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Omnath, Locus of Creation. It also utilizes Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for added value. The inclusion of cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler help to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure the deck has access to all colors needed to cast its spells efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through a combination of control elements and powerful threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently deploy a board full of artifacts to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Urza, Lord High Artificer, Memnite, and Thought Monitor, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Cards like Esper Sentinel and Metallic Rebuke help to control the opponent's board while Thoughtcast and Teferi, Time Raveler provide card draw and disruption. Urza's Saga is a key card that can help generate additional artifacts to fuel the deck's aggressive strategy.

The deck revolves around utilizing Indomitable Creativity to combo off with cards like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, creating unexpected and powerful interactions. It leverages a mix of control elements such as Spell Pierce and Prismari Command to protect and enhance its combo pieces. The deck also includes utility cards like Wrenn and Six for card advantage and consistency. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the combo pieces and ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to surprise and overwhelm opponents with its creative combos.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and creating tokens with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also includes cards like Prismari Command and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the combo pieces and ensure consistency in casting spells. The deck aims to surprise and overwhelm the opponent with its creative interactions and strong creatures, ultimately leading to victory through explosive plays.

The deck focuses on combining the ramping abilities of cards like Azusa, Cultivator Colossus, and Sakura-Tribe Elder with the land synergies of Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to quickly and efficiently play Primeval Titan. With Primeval Titan's ability to fetch utility lands like Vesuva, Valakut, and Sunhome, the deck can create overwhelming board states and finish the game with powerful attacks. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption, while Urza's Saga serves as a powerful engine to fetch essential artifacts. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creature attacks.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to combo with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to create a loop that mills the opponent's deck and ultimately wins through cards like Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces while also providing options for different colored mana requirements. Overall, the key concept is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and win the game through milling or card advantage.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities in order to create powerful interactions and combos. Using creatures like Scavenging Ooze, Geralf's Messenger, and Young Wolf alongside cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, the deck aims to create a toolbox of creatures that can either beat down the opponent or combo off for a win. This strategy is supported by mana ramp and tutor cards like Birds of Paradise, Wall of Roots, Chord of Calling, and Eldritch Evolution to help find and utilize the right creatures for the situation.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing Cascade mechanics to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By casting cards with Cascade, such as Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the player can easily put pressure on the opponent while potentially getting additional spells for free. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Subtlety to control the board. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently casting spells with Cascade to create a fast-paced and powerful game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to fill the graveyard quickly, before casting Living End to bring back powerful creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Grief from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Subtlety and Force of Negation to protect the combo. The strategy revolves around cycling through cards efficiently and controlling the board until the combo can be executed, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and disruption. The mana base includes a mix of fetchlands and shocklands to ensure consistency and access to all necessary colors.

The main concept of this deck is to use cards that cycle through the deck and creatures with high mana costs in order to quickly fill up the graveyard. Once the graveyard is full, the player can cast Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield, often overwhelming the opponent with a large army of creatures. The deck also includes disruption elements such as Force of Negation to protect the combo. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly filling up the graveyard and then unleashing a powerful creature army.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling a powerful board presence by utilizing cards that generate creature tokens and sacrifice engines like Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven. The key strategy revolves around utilizing The Underworld Cookbook to churn out food tokens and generate card advantage. By sacrificing creatures and artifacts, the deck aims to use Finale of Devastation to tutor for specific threats from the library and overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures. The deck also includes utility lands like Urza's Saga to provide additional resources and synergies with the main game plan.

The focus of this deck is to maintain control of the board while also maintaining a fast and aggressive pace. By utilizing cards that allow for card advantage and disruption (such as Mishra's Bauble, Archmage's Charm, and Counterspell), the player can quickly deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes removal options like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.
